scope: Only a hand-coded length rule and literal string processing. Useful content and arithmetic are reviewed separately by reading the text, not by these counts. No model judge was invoked. ByteTokenizer/CharTokenizer are local deterministic representations with no data/model loading.

cases.name: original-10-repeats
cases.executed_code:
short = "答案是4。"
long = short * 10
candidates = [short, long]
lengths = [len(text) for text in candidates]
chosen = max(candidates, key=len)
print("字元數", lengths)
print("長度裁判選長版", chosen == long)
print("不同句子數", len(set(long.split("。")[:-1])))
cases.stdout:
字元數 [5, 50]
長度裁判選長版 True
不同句子數 1
